tool_args.rationale: The zero-step row gives y = x_now, and every nonzero-step residual has the sign of the step. The four transient observations do not separate step normalization from horizon decay well enough to commit to a model at the requested RMSE tolerance. The trajectory batch is the only relevant probe on the menu.

considered_alternatives.option: Baseline plus a single exponential step response
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: After subtracting x_now and dividing by the signed step, the apparent decay rate varies across the four nonzero-step rows. Step magnitude and horizon vary together, so the pilot does not isolate the cause.

considered_alternatives.option: Normalized step response with horizon decay
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot supports a signed step response but has too little step-magnitude variation to distinguish normalization from a different horizon-decay law.
Varying the auxiliary inputs does not address the ambiguity between step normalization and horizon decay.
